lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
@nextcloud/files: 49,020 B in 16 modules on the ebookreader-main page, of which its root dist/index.mjs is 29,455 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
All 3 pages load the same 1 file: 1,593 B raw, 859 B gzip, 36.6 % of the smallest page (ebookreader-viewer, 4,354 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/router 1,537 B, generated by vite 56 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 58,017 B on the ebookreader-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
58 B in 2 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
